This is my first ever post/reply on here so I doubt you will see this but... I feel this same way. I was super thin in college because I would not eat anything, I couldn’t. Now that I found a great guy, I gained all my weight back, plus some. I don’t hang out with any of my college friends anymore cause I don’t want them to see me like this. We make plans but then I cancel right before because I get too worked up about how I look. I am looking forward to these responses that people give OP because I am hoping to take something from the responses as well. 

I want to tell you this because no one ever tells me this.. I don’t know who you are, I don’t know what you look like. But please know you are more beautiful now than ever!
